detail.longDescription: I've been working on and off on this project to have a reasonably easy way to run a docker sandbox on my machine. Recently with claude "auto mode" not working as "automatically" as before I resurrected this. Hopefully it is of use to you too. Usage: sclaude / scodex just like you'd call claude or codex. To update: sclaude update (updates the script and tooling) It runs locally in a container. Docker also works via Docker-in-Docker (but can be turned off). Feedback welcome!
